description:
The purpose of this notice is to:

-Update industry on the United States Census Bureau (USCB) 2030 Census Questionnaire Assistance (CQA) requirement.

-Identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for 2030 CQA.

-Request vendor feedback that can contribute to determining the final method of acquisition.

-Provide notice/instruction for the 2030 CQA Virtual Industry Day.

Please see the attached documents: 

-Market Research, Capability Call, and Virtual Industry Day Announcement: 2030 Census Questionnaire Assistance (CQA)

-Draft 2030 CQA Requirements Document (PDF File)

-2030 CQA Questions & Comments Template (Excel File).

Final Responses to this Notice and the Requirements Document are due no later than 4:00 pm EST, May 15, 2026.

The CQA virtual Industry Day will be held Thursday, May 7, 2026, from 1:00 pm EST to 2:00 pm EST. Questions to be considered for Industry Day response must be submitted no later than 4:00 pm EST on April 27, 2026. Please read this notice and associated instructions carefully as you must register to attend this industry day.
